referents.why: 'On it' (masculine singular) is the sea of 38:8, not offered as a candidate.
First person 'my boundaries': the speaker, the LORD.
First person subject of the wayyiqtol 'I fixed': the speaker, the LORD.
First person subject of 'I set in place': the speaker, the LORD.

links.why: A self-link. The wayyiqtol cannot be then-linked to itself, and 'then' runs within a verse only.
The wayyiqtol 'I set in place' continues the narrative line from 'I fixed'.

cant_tell.why: A cross-verse relation. The verse-level link types cannot express it, so it is not recorded here.
